description: Handshake from a connection that only moves files and watches turn status (the desktop client's second connection): the optional agentStreams string is "none", so the daemon sends this session no agent_stream frame at all. Everything else still reaches it (agent_update, agent_ui_*, agent_timeline_reset, agent_todos_update, terminals_update, RPC replies). "all" is the default; any other value reads as "all". A daemon without the agentStreamsMode feature ignores the field and sends every stream, so a client must tolerate stream frames. daemon_status client entries show agentStreams for such a session.
